gloss: to go bald; to lose hair; to become bare

definitions.gloss: to go bald; to lose hair
definitions.explanation: To lose hair from the head, resulting in baldness. Can describe gradual thinning or complete hair loss.
Of a mountain, hillside or lawn, to lose its covering of trees or grass and become bare. Paint or a coating that wears off is {剥|は}げる, a different verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{禿|は}げて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father was bald from a young age.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げそうだ。
examples.english: I'm so stressed I feel like I'm going to go bald.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あたり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げてきた⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伐採|ばっさい}→伐採：08435_bassai⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧{禿|は}げてしまった。
examples.english: The trees on the mountain were felled and it became bare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}られ→切る：02693_kiru⟧、⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{禿|は}げてしまった。
examples.english: Development cleared the trees, leaving the hillside completely bare.

notes:
An ichidan (⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧) verb. Also written without kanji as はげる. The kanji {禿|は}げ can be sensitive as a noun referring to a bald person — use with care in conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げる: to go bald
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げる: a mountain becomes bare
- {禿|は}げ{上|あ}がる: to go completely bald (intensive)

WATCH OUT:
- Paint, plating or a coating that wears off takes ⟦{剥|は}げる→剥げる：29715_hageru⟧, a different verb with the same reading: ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}げる→剥げる：29715_hageru⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- {禿|は}げ: bald; bald person (noun) — can be considered rude
- ⟦{薄毛|うすげ}→薄毛：20459_usuge⟧: thinning hair — a more polite, euphemistic term
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: hair loss; hair removal — clinical/medical term
- ⟦{剥|は}がれる→剥がれる：04363_hagareru⟧: to peel off, come off — used for labels, stickers, surfaces
